author: /root/rectification_review_a

implementation.check: No --apply: compare only selected source and physical targets; do not enumerate full components or create installations. --print-manifest + --file prints only selected SHA records.
implementation.apply: Snapshot selected source bytes once, resolve selected aliases and preflight conflicting sources, dedupe physical destinations, skip matching SHA before staging, write/fsync one beside-target temporary file, copy source mode and os.replace only that physical file, read back SHA. No directory replacement/deletion in selective mode.
implementation.aliases: Selected logical roots/components may be aliases; their bodies remain untouched. Nested alias target must remain inside the canonical or explicitly requested component family. Same physical target is updated once; identical canonical aliases zero write. Different source bytes targeting the same physical file fail before any write.
implementation.partial_failure: Per-file failures report ERROR/PARTIAL and nonzero, preserve earlier successful updates without claiming rollback; retry skips already matched earlier files. No signed receipt, JSON permission, clean-tree or size threshold.
implementation.compatibility: No --file preserves existing explicit full --apply/check/--print-manifest behavior.
